text:
elaine: FYI PR #4567 is blocked in the docs review queue. The example under "Long-context streaming" uses an SDK snippet that relies on implicit KV cache behavior and we need runtime confirmation before we merge.

elaine: snippet below, suggests `stream=true, max_tokens=4096, keep_kv_cache=true` but runtime team says we don't expose `keep_kv_cache` in the public API? I'm not sure.

elaine: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
    model='redwood-long-8k',
    prompt=long_prompt,
    stream=True,
    max_tokens=4096,
    # docs currently show keep_kv_cache here (not in SDK types)
    keep_kv_cache=True,
)
```

sam: tagging @nick from eng-runtime — can you confirm what the public API surface actually supports and whether the behavior in the snippet is guaranteed (i.e., no silent truncation if the KV cache is evicted)? We need a 1-line answer to unblock the merge. :pray:

nick: quick note: `keep_kv_cache` was an internal flag during prototyping and isn't a supported parameter on the public REST/SDK surface. The runtime preserves prefix KV entries automatically but cache eviction can happen on long-running sessions depending on host memory pressure. We do NOT guarantee zero truncation for arbitrary `max_tokens` values.

maria: okay — so docs should not show `keep_kv_cache`. What should the recommended example be instead?

nick: recommend removing `keep_kv_cache` and adding a short note: "For very long contexts, prefer a model with longer context window or use chunked generation; runtime may evict KV cache under memory pressure." That text is short and actionable.

elaine: also, CI docs preview failed for this PR because the example tried to run a quick linkcheck that hits the internal example-runner which expects the SDK param. Deploy bot log below:

deploy-bot: ```
ERROR: example-runner failed: TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'keep_kv_cache'
Build: docs-preview/branch-4567
```

sam: good catch. So fix the example -> remove flag -> re-run docs preview. Who's available to pick this up?

maria: I can update the PR this afternoon, remove the flag, and add the recommended note and a short code comment explaining chunking approach.

pm-john: from a product/pm perspective, it's fine to merge after the doc text is amended and CI preview passes. No need for a runtime code change.

elaine: great — can one of you also add a short line in the migration guide about older examples that referenced `keep_kv_cache` so users searching the docs won't be confused? Tiny redirect.

maria: will add migration note in the PR description and a sentence in the Long-context guide.

nick: +1. Also filing a tiny follow-up task for runtime infra to add a public-facing note about cache eviction behavior in the public runtime FAQ. Not blocking this merge.

elaine: awesome. Summary to unblock: (1) remove `keep_kv_cache` from SDK snippet, (2) add note about eviction and chunking, (3) re-run docs preview CI and confirm deploy-bot green. After that, reviewers can merge.

sam: thanks — tagging reviewers @mike and @jen for awareness. I'll re-request review once CI is green. :thumbsup:

elaine: merging timeline: we have a merge slot at 16:00 PT — if CI is green by 15:45 PT we can land in this day's merge window. If not, we'll queue for the next slot.

maria: working on it now, will post when preview link is up.

deploy-bot: preview ready: https://docs-preview.internal/branch-4567 — errors fixed.

elaine: looks good, thanks everyone. PR unblocked.
